    About Kiddo Arabia.

    Kiddo Arabia is a food brand bringing cereals, oat jars and oat biscuits together through distinctive characters and colorful packaging.

    Our range gives families different products to explore according to their preferences. We also welcome retailers and distributors worldwide who want to learn about the products and discuss cooperation.

    Explore our productsDiscuss a partnership

    The Kiddo range.

    A recognizable identity.

    Kiddo’s characters and package colors are central to the brand. They give individual products a distinctive face and connect the range through a shared character world for families to discover.
